cms-f0686.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0684.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
cms-f0684.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0584.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

cms-f0925.title: Make sure there is a pest control program to prevent/deal with mice, insects, or other pests.

cms-f0658.title: Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.
cms-f0658.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0677.title: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.
cms-f0677.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0842.title: Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
cms-f0842.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0919.title: Make sure that a working call system is available in each resident's  bathroom and bathing area.

cms-k0345.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.

cms-k0353.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.

cms-k0511.title: Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.

cms-k0712.title: Have simulated fire drills held at unexpected times.

cms-k0223.title: Provide exit doors that are held open by devices that will automatically close on the activation of a fire alarm or smoke detector.

cms-k0363.title: Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.

cms-k0372.title: Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.

cms-k0741.title: Have posted "No-smoking" signs in areas where smoking is not permitted or ashtrays provided where smoking was allowed.

cms-k0920.title: Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.
cms-k0920.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0923.title: Have proper medical gas storage and administration areas.
cms-k0923.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-f0580.title: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

cms-f0609.title: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
cms-f0609.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0656.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
cms-f0656.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0695.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
cms-f0695.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0725.title: Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.

cms-f0726.title: Ensure that nurses and nurse aides have the appropriate competencies to care for every resident in a way that maximizes each resident's well being.

cms-f0755.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.

cms-f0761.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

cms-f0838.title: Conduct and document a facility-wide assessment to determine what resources are necessary to care for residents competently during both day-to-day operations (including nights and weekends) and emergencies.

cms-f0880.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

cms-f0883.title: Develop and implement policies and procedures for flu and pneumonia vaccinations.

cms-f0550.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

cms-f0558.title: Reasonably accommodate the needs and preferences of each resident.

cms-f0610.title: Respond appropriately to all alleged violations.
cms-f0610.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0689.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
cms-f0689.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0693.title: Ensure that feeding tubes are  not used unless there is a medical reason and the resident agrees; and provide appropriate care for a resident with a feeding tube.
cms-f0693.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0698.title: Provide safe, appropriate dialysis care/services for a resident who requires such services.
cms-f0698.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0756.title: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

cms-f0758.title: Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.

cms-f0760.title: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

cms-f0909.title: Regularly inspect all bed frames, mattresses, and bed rails (if any) for safety; and all bed rails and mattresses must attach safely to the bed frame.

cms-k0907.title: Ensure medical gas and vacuum systems have documented maintenance programs.
cms-k0907.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-f0810.title: Provide special eating equipment and utensils for residents who need them and appropriate assistance.

cms-f0692.title: Provide enough food/fluids to maintain a resident's health.
cms-f0692.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0921.title: Make sure that the nursing home area is safe, easy to use, clean and comfortable for residents, staff and the public.

cms-f0625.title: Notify the resident or the resident’s representative in writing how long the nursing home will hold the resident’s bed in cases of transfer to a hospital or therapeutic leave.

cms-f0561.title: Honor the resident's right to and the facility must promote and facilitate resident self-determination through support of resident choice.

cms-e0030.title: List the names and contact information of those in the facility.

cms-k0918.title: Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
cms-k0918.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-e0007.title: Address patient/client population and determine types of services needed.

cms-k0374.title: Install smoke barrier doors that can resist smoke for at least 20 minutes.

cms-f0678.title: Provide basic life support, including CPR, prior to the arrival of emergency medical personnel , subject to physician orders and the resident’s advance directives.
cms-f0678.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0585.title: Honor the resident's right to voice grievances without discrimination or reprisal and the facility must establish a grievance policy and make prompt efforts to resolve grievances.

cms-f0607.title: Develop and implement policies and procedures to prevent abuse, neglect, and theft.
cms-f0607.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0812.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

cms-f0759.title: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

cms-k0355.title: Properly select, install, inspect, or maintain portable fire extinguishes.

cms-k0761.title: To conduct inspection, testing and maintenance of fire doors by qualified individuals.

cms-f0568.title: Properly hold, secure, and manage each resident's personal money which is deposited with the nursing home.

cms-f0570.title: Assure the security of all personal funds of residents deposited with the facility.

cms-f0582.title: Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.

cms-f0700.title: Try different approaches before using a bed rail.  If a bed rail is needed, the facility must (1) assess a resident for safety risk; (2) review these risks and benefits with the resident/representative; (3) get informed consent; and (4) Correctly install and maintain the bed rail.
cms-f0700.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0623.title: Provide timely notification to the resident, and if applicable to the resident representative and ombudsman, before transfer or discharge, including appeal rights.
